articles.title: Veteran Telugu actor Giri Babu passes away at 80 in Hyderabad; Chiranjeevi, Mohan Babu, Nandamuri Balakrishna and others mourn his demise
articles.summary: Veteran Telugu actor Yerra Seshagiri Rao, better known as Giri Babu, passed away on Saturday at a private hospital in Hyderabad.
articles.body: Veteran Telugu actor Yerra Seshagiri Rao, better known as Giri Babu, passed away on Saturday at a private hospital in Hyderabad. He was 80 and was reportedly being treated for health problems linked to his age. Leading names from the film industry and politics have since shared emotional tributes.Last rites and public homageThe Movie Artistes Association (MAA) offered condolences to the family of its life member. According to its statement, his mortal remains will be kept at the Film Chamber from 7 pm to 9 pm on Saturday so that people can pay their respects. The final rites will take place on Sunday between 3 pm and 4 pm at Ravinuthala, near Medarametla.Chiranjeevi pays tribute to Giri BabuMegastar Chiranjeevi said he was shocked to hear the news. He remembered Giri Babu’s work as an actor, producer and director in Telugu cinema, adding that his unique style and varied performances would never be forgotten. Calling the death a huge loss for the industry, he prayed for peace to the departed soul and sent his condolences to the family and fans.Mohan Babu recalls their early days in MadrasAccording to the Deccan Chronicle, Mohan Babu, who shared a close personal bond with the late actor, appeared deeply moved. He revealed that the two lived together as roommates in their struggling days in Madras and were very close friends.“When we were in Madras, Giribabu and I were roommates. He entered the film industry before me, and we went on to act in each other’s films. He was a large-hearted person who excelled in several distinctive roles. He achieved success as an actor, director and producer. I am unable to find words to express my grief. I pray for peace to his soul and strength to his family,” he said.Nandamuri Balakrishna remembers working with Giri BabuThe reported added that Nandamuri Balakrishna said he had worked with Giri Babu in the early phase of his career and that the actor was part of many of his films.“I acted with him in ‘Annadammula Anubandham’ at the beginning of my career. He played important roles in many of my films. Giribabu was not just a good actor but also a wonderful human being. His absence is irreparable,” Balakrishna said. He also offered his condolences to Raghu Babu and the rest of the family.Pawan Kalyan praises his versatilityAndhra Pradesh Deputy Chief Minister Pawan Kalyan also paid tribute, recalling how Giri Babu made his mark in different kinds of roles. He said the actor was equally effective as a villain, a hero and a character artiste, and also had a fine sense of humour. Pawan Kalyan added that Giri Babu was a successful producer and director too. He prayed for his soul to rest in peace and extended his sympathies to Raghu Babu and the family.Giri Babu’s film journey spanning five decadesBorn in Ravinuthala in Prakasam district, Giri Babu entered films with ‘Jagame Maya’. He began his career as a hero, then moved on to play villains and comedy roles, and eventually became a well-known face in supporting parts. Over nearly five decades, he worked in more than 600 films. He also directed and produced a few movies. articles.title: Princess Diana’s legendary White House dance with John Travolta almost didn’t happen
articles.summary: Princess Diana danced with Clint Eastwood, Tom Selleck and Ronald Reagan that evening, but it took coaxing to get John Travolta onto the floor.
articles.body: John Travolta had all the right moves, but when the chance to dance with Princess Diana came along, even Hollywood's smoothest dancer got cold feet. The Princess of Wales and the actor lit up the White House ballroom in 1985, creating one of the most unforgettable moments in royal and Hollywood history. Diana was attending a White House dinner hosted by President Ronald Reagan and first lady Nancy Reagan when she took a spin with the heartthrob. More than four decades later, their legendary dance is being celebrated at "Princess Diana: Love, Life, Legacy — A Life of Giving," an exhibition at the Ronald Reagan Presidential Library in Simi Valley, California. More than 700 artifacts connected to Diana's life are on display. PRINCESS DIANA, HOT DOGS AND A PRESIDENTIAL MATCHMAKING ATTEMPT: ICONIC ROYAL VISITS TO AMERICA The collection, presented through a partnership between the Ronald Reagan Presidential Foundation and Institute (RRPFI) and Renae Plant's Princess Diana Museum, features the velvet gown designed by Victor Edelstein that Diana wore that night. But the iconic dance nearly didn't happen. "In preparation for the state dinner, the Marine Band that was going to perform the music during the dinner was told to rehearse music from 'Saturday Night Fever,'" Melissa Giller, chief marketing and cultural programming officer at RRPFI, told Fox News Digital. WATCH: PRINCESS DIANA'S ICONIC DANCE WITH TRAVOLTA GETS NEW SPOTLIGHT "The social secretary, Gahl Burt, she orchestrated it after speaking with Mrs. Reagan that after the dancing began, Gahl would walk up to John Travolta and tap him on the shoulder and encourage him to have a dance with Princess Diana," Giller said. "Now through the whole evening, Princess Diana danced with Ronald Reagan. She danced with Clint Eastwood. She danced with Tom Selleck and many others." But when it came time for Travolta to step onto the dance floor with Diana, he needed some coaxing. "When it was time, Gahl Burt walked up to John Travolta and tapped him on the shoulder," Giller said. "He was actually a bit hesitant. He didn't know if it was something he should do. But after some encouragement, he went up and asked the princess to dance." Travolta mustered the courage and approached Diana. The two then waltzed across the checkered floor to music from "Saturday Night Fever." "They ended up dancing for 15 minutes," Giller said with a smile. "Every presidential library archive has a photo that's the most requested by the public. President Nixon's library is the photo of Elvis meeting President Nixon. And one of our most requested photos is the one of Princess Diana dancing with John Travolta." GET ENTERTAINMENT SCOOP DELIVERED RIGHT TO YOUR EMAIL BY CLICKING HERE Travolta later admitted he was nervous before approaching Diana. "I didn't think they'd ask me to dance with her," he told Esquire Mexico in 2021. "I had the great privilege and honor of doing so, and I thought, 'There must be a reason for doing this and I better give it my all.’ That meant lead the dance well and make sure we had fun. That was the easy part, but just the fact of greeting Diana appropriately, being confident and asking her to dance was a complicated task." The "Grease" star also recalled how special it was to dance with Diana. "Think of the setting. We were at the White House. It's midnight. The stage is like a dream. I approach her, touch her elbow, invite her to dance," he said. "She spins around and gives me that captivating smile, just a little sad, and accepts my invitation. And there we were, dancing together as if it were a fairytale." In the 2021 interview, Travolta also recalled his disbelief over the once-in-a-lifetime encounter. "Who could imagine that something like this is going to happen to you one day? I was smart enough to register it in my memory as a very special, magical moment." LIKE WHAT YOU'RE READING? CLICK HERE FOR MORE ENTERTAINMENT NEWS Travolta also told Dutch television station Één that it was Nancy who told him Diana wanted to dance with him. "[She] said, 'It is her wish,'" the actor recalled. "At midnight, I had to tap her on her shoulder, and I had to say, 'Would you care to dance?' She turned around and dipped her head in that Lady Diana way, and we were off for 15 minutes dancing." "I'll never forget it," he continued. "I'm so honored that I was able to experience this, and I know for a fact that it was her highlight of being in the United States; it was her favorite moment. So I feel I made her life better, she made my life better, and I'm very sorry that she's not here." During a 2016 appearance on "Good Morning America," Travolta was asked if there was anything from the 1980s that he'd like to bring back to the 2010s. He said he'd love to dance with Diana again. "That was one of the highlights of my life, so that's probably the best moment of the '80s." Giller noted that the Prince and Princess of Wales maintained a close friendship with the Reagans. PUT YOUR ENTERTAINMENT KNOWLEDGE TO THE TEST AND SEE HOW YOU SCORE "When Princess Diana got married to Prince Charles, Ronald Reagan, as President of the United States, could not go because the assassination attempt happened a few months ago and he was [still] recovering," Giller explained. "So, Mrs. Reagan went on behalf of President Reagan, as well as the United States. And I think that sort of bonded her with Princess Diana, although of course, Mrs. Reagan was much older than Princess Diana." "They shared a kinship, especially once Princess Diana became a mother," Giller said. "You can see that in [their] letters and their relationship." The exhibition features letters Nancy and Diana wrote to each other over the years, as well as gifts the Reagans received from the Prince and Princess of Wales. Giller said the exhibition aims to show visitors the woman behind the royal title, highlighting Diana's humanitarian work and influence beyond her relationship with the Reagans. "This isn't just an exhibition about dresses and shoes and jewelry," she said. "This is an exhibition about a woman who truly cared about her family, about her people, about all people, not just those in Europe, but around the world." articles.title: Magic: The Gathering is getting a Netflix animated series. For real this time.
articles.summary: Magic The Gathering: Planeswalker is set to debut on Netflix in 2027.
articles.body: “It’s really happening. I promise. For real.” Those are the first words from Roy Graham, Head of Story at Magic: The Gathering, in a video posted yesterday announcing Planeswalker, the animated series heading to Netflix in 2027. An animated Magic: The Gathering series was first teased back in 2019 with Joe and Anthony Russo at the helm. But that fell apart. In 2024, Netflix announced it still planned to make a series based on the game, but it decided to rework it from the ground up. Now fans are finally getting their first glimpse of the show, which will be called Planeswalker. According to the sneak peek, because each plane exists in its own pocket universe, it will have a unique design, animation, and filmmaking style. According to a synopsis of the show shared with IGN, Planeswalker will focus on Chandra Nalaar, a “volatile pyromancer hunted for her gifts, and haunted by her past.” Storyline details beyond that are vague, other than mentioning an “insidious force” that Chandra and other Planeswalkers will team up to confront “to prevent a cataclysmic war that threatens to consume their very existence.”

articles.title: Women celebrate Chhath rituals on Day 2
articles.summary: Women observe Kharna on Day 2 of Chhath Puja in Lucknow, taking holy dips in Gomti, offering prayers to Surya Dev and beginning a 36-hour fast.
articles.body: Lucknow: The banks of Gomti were crowded on Saturday with women celebrating Kharna, the second day of the Chhath festival. Amid devotional chants and the gentle ripples of the river, devotees took a holy dip and offered prayers to Surya Dev, marking the beginning of the rigorous 36-hour Chhath fast.On Kharna, women observe Nirjala Upvaas (abstaining from both food and water) from sunrise to sunset. The 36-hour fast will end on Monday, when devotees break it after offering ‘Usha Arghya’ to the rising sun. As part of the Kharna rituals, a special prasad comprising jaggery kheer and roti or puri is prepared.For Naina Kumari, a native of Chhapra, Kharna is as much about spiritual cleansing as about religious observance. “On Kharna, I abstain from all worldly pleasures and don’t watch TV or use my mobile phone for movies, songs or news. I sit in a room and chant mantras,” she said.Newlywed Sujata Singh, stepping out of the river at Laxman Mela Ground after offering arghya, said, “Today, we are invoking Surya Dev’s blessings as we prepare to begin the Chhath fast tonight.”Holding a puja thali, Chandini Raawat said devotees had gathered for the aavahan, or invocation, of Surya Dev before beginning the 36-hour fast.For Kamini Yadav, the festival brought a special family reunion. “After a long time, we have gathered at our in-laws’ home. articles.title: Vallejo, brillante ganador del IX Festival Salamanca Cuna del Ajedrez Moderno
articles.summary: Sivanandan, mejor participante femenina
articles.body: Francisco Vallejo, pentacampeón de España, vuelve a la senda de los triunfos después de muchos meses de inactividad. Y qué mejor manera de hacerlo que en el IX Festival Salamanca Cuna del Ajedrez Moderno. El menorquín ha conseguido una prestigiosa victoria en solitario encabezando la clasificación de principio a fin, con punto y medio de ventaja sobre el mexicano José Eduardo Martínez Alcántara. La inglesa Bodhana Sivanandan, la mejor participante femenina, ha ocupado la cuarta posición. El talento de Vallejo es innegable, reconocido por jugadores de super élite como por ejemplo el indio Viswanathan Anand, cinco veces campeón del mundo. Desde los 8 años comenzó a cosechar resultados brillantes, que alcanzaron uno de sus momentos destacados cuando con 18 conquistó el título mundial de la categoría. Actuaciones notables en Linares o en otros torneos de renombre internacional quedan ya alejadas en el tiempo, pero no su comprensión del ajedrez. En los últimos años, asuntos personales, unidos a su residencia en Asunción (Paraguay), le han restado mucha energía y por eso apenas ha competido hasta el punto de que declinó participar con la selección española -fijo indiscutible en el equipo- en la última Olimpiada celebrada en Samarcanda (Uzbekistán) el pasado mes de septiembre. En Salamanca, prueba previa a su presencia en el próximo Campeonato de España por Equipos de División de Honor que se disputará en Marbella (Málaga) del 20 al 26 de noviembre, Vallejo ha exhibido un gran rendimiento y su actuación (performance) ha sido de ¡¡¡2810!!!, o lo que es lo mismo, superior en 5 unidades a la que hubiera tenido que hacer el noruego Magnus Carlsen para no perder Elo. Números que explican mejor que mil palabras su juego en la ciudad universitaria. Vallejo afrontaba las dos últimas rondas del torneo, que se disputaba en la modalidad de 45 minutos más 5 segundos adicionales por movimiento en el Centro Internacional del Español, con medio punto de ventaja sobre Martínez Alcántara. Necesitaba dos victorias para asegurar de manera matemática el primer premio. Y así lo hizo, derrotando en primer lugar a Sivanandan. Y a continuación a la alemana Elisabeth Paehtz. Fueron victorias de la experiencia, en las que la diferencia de nivel terminó notándose cuando comenzaron las complicaciones. Martínez Alcántara ganó a Paehtz, pero en su intento de inquietar a Vallejo asumió demasiados riesgos con las piezas negras en su duelo con el neerlandés Loek van Wely. Este, pese a disponer de menos tiempo, no dio ninguna opción y consiguió el punto en disputa en 52 movimientos, con solo 21 segundos en el reloj por más de 22 minutos de su adversario. Excelente experiencia de Sivanandan, de 12 años, frente a jugadores del top mundial. Aunque consiguió buenas posiciones, sus constantes apuros de tiempo terminaron pasándole factura contra los representantes masculinos. Sin embargo, contra sus contrarias femeninas, consiguió 3 puntos de 4 posibles, con una actuación de 2450 Elo cuando el suyo es de 2414. El IX Festival Salamanca Cuna del Ajedrez Moderno está organizado y patrocinado por el Ayuntamiento de Salamanca, la Universidad de Salamanca y Alumni, con el apoyo de la Junta de Castilla y León. Novena ronda: Martínez Alcántara-Paehtz, 1-0; Hnatyshyn-Van Wely, 0-1; Vallejo-Sivanandan, 1-0. Décima y última ronda: Paehtz-Vallejo, 0-1; Sivanandan-Hnatyshyn, 1-0; Van Wely-Martínez Alcántara, 1-0. Clasificación final: 1º, Vallejo (España), 8,5; 2º, Martínez Alcántara (México), 7; 3º, Van Wely (Países Bajos), 6,5; 4ª, Sivanandan (Inglaterra), 3,5; 5ª, Paehtz (Alemania), 3; 6ª, Hnatyshyn (Ucrania), 1,5.

articles.title: DC United part ways with head coach René Weiler
articles.summary: By Jonathan SigalD.C. United have parted ways with head coach René Weiler, the club announced Saturday.The decision comes one week after D.C.'s 2026 season e...
articles.body:
D.C. United have parted ways with head coach René Weiler, the club announced Saturday.

The decision comes one week after D.C.'s 2026 season ended with a 14th-place finish in the Eastern Conference (33 points). They placed 28th out of 30 teams in the overall league standings.

A veteran Swiss coach, Weiler was appointed in July 2025 and departs with an 8W-19L-16D record (all competitions) spanning a season and a half.

"We would like to thank René for his commitment and contributions to D.C. United. We wish him and his family all the best," said Dr. Erkut Sogut, D.C. United's managing director of soccer operations.

According to The Athletic's Tom Bogert , D.C. are nearing a deal to appoint former Orlando City , FC Dallas and Colorado Rapids coach Oscar Pareja as Weiler's successor. Pareja has more than a decade of MLS coaching experience.

The Black-and-Red last made the postseason in 2019. Ahead of the 2026 campaign, they acquired forwards Louis Munteanu and Tai Baribo as Designated Players.

articles.body:
In a recent report , Tuttomercatoweb claimed that Arsenal are set to rival Brighton and Hove Albion for AC Milan playmaker Alphadjo Cisse. It has been mentioned that the Gunners are showing interest in recruiting the Italian attacker next year.

Cisse has enjoyed a good run of form at the Italian club this season as he has put in a string of impressive displays for them on the offensive end of the field. The 20-year-old has banged in eight goals in 13 matches for AC Milan in this campaign so far across all competitions.

The Italian talent is currently one of the most promising young playmakers in Serie A . Hence, the Gunners would do well to get a deal done for him next year.

His current contract at the Italian club will run out in the summer of 2030, which could make it difficult for Arsenal to land him on a cut-price deal this January or at the end of this campaign.

MILAN, ITALY – NOVEMBER 05: Alphadjo Cisse of AC Milan warms up before the UEFA Europa League 2026/27 League Phase MD4 match between AC Milan and Ferencvarosi TC at Stadio San Siro on November 05, 2026 in Milan, Italy. (Photo by Marco Luzzani/Getty Images)

What Will Cisse Bring To Arsenal Boss Mikel Arteta's Side?

Cisse can shoot the ball with power from long range and has the vision to engineer a few inviting chances for his teammates in and around the opponent's goal. He is a good dribbler with the ball at his feet and can chip in by scoring his fair share of goals up top.

The Italian youngster is primarily an attacking midfielder but can also fill in as a striker or as a box-to-box midfielder if told to do so. However, there are some question marks on whether he can cope with the physical side and high intensity of the Premier League if the Gunners manage to snap him up in 2027.

We can expect Cisse to bring more firepower to Arsenal head coach Mikel Arteta's frontline. He is already good enough to challenge for a regular first-team spot at the Emirates Stadium in the coming years.

At 20, the future looks quite promising for Cisse as long as he continues to improve with each season. He would also help Arsenal compete across all fronts in the future. Cisse is undoubtedly a prospect to watch out for in the long run, so Arteta should focus on signing him next year.
